identity.title: Prevent incompatible tool insertion and automatic input routing

origin.summary: Adding measurement tools from All tools produced persistently invalid routes instead of requiring a compatible typed input.

state.current_summary: The shared Add boundary now resolves only compatible typed inputs, exposes the proposed route before insertion, blocks transformed-only tools without a transformed artifact, and gives loadable legacy mismatches a direct non-executing repair action. Focused, regression, Release-build, save/reopen, and current EXE Wide/Compact checks pass.

claims.text: All tools can insert a HeightField consumer after a Thickness MeasurementResult, silently route the incompatible result, and save/reopen the invalid step.

problem.impact: An operator can spend time teaching or debugging a recipe that could never satisfy its typed input contract, and the saved file looks structurally legitimate until a later requirement is inspected.

criteria.text: Add is unavailable or requires an explicit compatible route whenever the proposed input contract is not satisfied.
A HeightField consumer is never automatically routed to a MeasurementResult, and the proposed input/output types are visible before insertion.
Save/reopen preserves every valid explicit route, invalid legacy routes receive a direct repair action, and no Add or repair action starts Preview, Publish, or Run.

context.summary: Seven independent EXE-authored variants route the added HeightField consumer to derived.pad-thickness.08.
Filter -> Thickness saves, but ROI teaching cannot start for the selected routed input and two execution requirements remain.

artifacts.summary: Ten saved and reopened current-format recipe files.

evidence.kind: current-Release EXE reproduction and persisted JSON inspection
evidence.observation: Warpage, Plane Flatness, Gap / Flush, Volume, Cross-section Dimensions, Point Pair Dimensions, and Completeness Grid were each added through All tools after an eight-step Thickness baseline. Every saved file reopened through the EXE, retained two execution requirements, and persisted derived.pad-thickness.08 as the new step input even though the added tool requires a HeightField.

Current source passes Tool Recipe teaching 42/42, Height Measurement Workbench 54/54, Recipe Manager + WPG 40/40, Tool Recipe selections 29/29, Artifact Navigator, and the full Release solution build with zero warnings and zero errors. The focused checks cover compatible input selection, unavailable transformed-only Add, visible proposed contracts, legacy mismatch load/repair, valid route save/reopen, and absence of Preview, Publish, or Run from Add and repair.

The current Release EXE was exercised on leftmost DISPLAY2. Wide and Compact show incompatible Plane Flatness Add disabled without a TransformedHeightField, Warpage proposed against and inserted from the source HeightField without execution, and the saved legacy Plane Flatness step with a direct English/Korean Repair route action. Activating repair expands Inputs and advanced route editing while the header remains Saved with the same three execution requirements; no Preview, Publish, Run, or save occurs.

events.summary: PL-0009 implementation started from the confirmed current-Release EXE reproduction.
Compatible typed insertion, proposed-route visibility, loadable legacy repair, and explicit no-auto-execution behavior are verified and complete.
